answer: Three options. (1) Upsert sink keyed by product_id and window_start, so the replayed emission overwrites the pre-crash row and the latest wins. (2) Transactional sink that commits output in the same transaction as the offsets, so writes after the last checkpoint are never committed. (3) Dedupe view on the read side, using ROW_NUMBER over (product_id, window_start) ordered by emitted_at DESC and keeping rn = 1. Prefer the upsert when the sink supports it: the view adds a window function to every query and leaves orphan rows in the table, while the upsert keeps one correct row per window at write time.
